zeroPaidCalls.statement: this stage reads local audio + a committed RESULT.json only; it opens no socket and makes no DashScope / Qwen / Omni request

incumbentCleanBaseline.classificationRule: status!=timeout → clean; timeout ∧ 1 stop ∧ unattributed → measurement-false-negative; otherwise → real-pollution
incumbentCleanBaseline.note: the clean end-wait p90 is read off the incumbent's OWN observable latency (`userWaitEndpointMs`, onset → upstream speech_stopped), pooled across both levels' clean eot sessions. Its n is printed; it is small and NOT a field estimate.

gate.note: pre-registered before reading the sweep; budgets are fractions

stage2.triggerReason: Stage 1 IS sufficient at the 0.10 budget (VAD@800) but NOT at eot-bench's tighter 0.02/0.05 budgets — see stage1Gate.budgetSensitivity, where no threshold passes. Per the task ("仅在阶段 1 不够用时"), the marginal Stage-1 result triggers this zero-cost robustness cross-check.

cost.statement: no model is re-invoked: Smart Turn / LiveKit rows are READ from P0.7's committed RESULT.json; VAD rows come from this run's stage1Sweep; the only execution is a local filesystem probe for turn-1-mini, which opens no socket

detectors.source: P0.7 committed RESULT.json unifiedReplay.batch.groups.B (read, not re-run)
detectors.note: the SWEEP's own bestAtBudget pick for group B is the degenerate threshold-0.99 point (cutoff 0, missed-end 0.977) — it minimises cutoff by never firing, so its F1 is 0.044. The best-F1 frontier point is the one reported for the tradeoff; it is OVER the 0.10 cutoff budget (cutoff 0.137931), which is the finding: Smart Turn cannot both hit the budget and keep its F1.

detectors.source: P0.7 committed RESULT.json unifiedReplay.batch.groups.C (read, not re-run)
detectors.frameworkCaveat: the framework local transport keeps a 1.2 s ring buffer, so a cell deeper than 1.2 s asks the model about the same audio content as the 1.2 s cell; only the reported silence duration differs. The score curve flattens past 1.2 s for that reason, not because the model "saw" the extra silence.

detectors.note: NOT INSTALLED in this environment — no package, no importable module, no local checkout. No number is reported for this row; it is neither measured nor silently dropped.

baseline.source: this run's stage1Sweep, via the same eot-bench sweep as P0.7

rows.detector: Smart Turn v3.2 ONNX (CPU) — best-F1 frontier

stage2Gate.note: pre-registered: a local MODEL must clear the SAME 0.10 cutoff budget and 0.10 missed-end budget as Stage 1, and be no slower than the Stage-1 sufficient point, to count as an improvement
